description: This file defines classes and structures for subgraph pattern matching and rewriting within a graph, including Match, MatchFilter, SubgraphMatcher, RewriteRule, and SubgraphRewriter, used in graph optimization or transformation processes.

classes.name: Match
classes.description: Holds mappings between pattern nodes/values and target graph nodes/values, including a map for constant attributes.

classes.name: SubgraphMatcher
classes.description: Performs pattern matching of subgraphs within a larger graph, supporting matching from a root node and multiple matches.

classes.name: SubgraphRewriter
classes.description: Handles registration of rewrite patterns and applies subgraph rewriting rules to graphs.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the node and value mappings of a Match object to a stream.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Attempts to match the pattern starting from a specific node in the target graph.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Finds all matches of the pattern within a target graph.

methods.name: findRootNode
methods.description: Finds the root output node of a graph to start pattern matching.

methods.name: tryMatchNode
methods.description: Tries to match a pattern node with a target node, considering node type and inputs.

methods.name: tryMatchNodeInputs
methods.description: Matches inputs of pattern and target nodes.

methods.name: isOutputValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is an output of its graph.

methods.name: registerRewritePattern
methods.description: Registers a subgraph pattern and its replacement for rewriting.

methods.name: runForPattern
methods.description: Executes subgraph rewriting on a graph for a specific pattern and replacement.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the subgraph rewriting process with optional filters.

methods.name: overlapsWithUsedNodes
methods.description: Checks if a match overlaps with already replaced nodes.

methods.name: rewriteMatch
methods.description: Performs rewriting of matched subgraphs within a graph.

methods.name: getVmap
methods.description: Generates a mapping from pattern graph to values.
